_comment: The only openclaw.json change needed after installing the plugin.
Set agents.defaults.model to the new backend ID + model name.
The backend ID is 'claude-agent-sdk' (registered by index.mjs).
Replace 'claude-sonnet-4-6' with whichever model you have access to.
There is no longer a cliBackends override required — the plugin declares
command, args, resumeArgs, and all CliBackendConfig fields itself.
